charts.title: Influencer marketing market size worldwide from 2016 to 2024 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Global influencer marketing value 2016-2024
charts.description: The global influencer marketing market size has more than tripled since 2019. In 2024, the market was estimated to reach a record of 24 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Influencer marketing platform market size worldwide from 2022 to 2025 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Influencer marketing platform market size worldwide 2022-2025
charts.description: In 2022, the global influencer marketing platform market was valued at 15.2 billion U.S. dollars. It is expected to further grow to 17.4 billion in 2023 and surpass 22 billion dollars in 2025. The influencer marketing platforms are used in search and discovery of clients, campaign management, influencer relationship management, as well as analytics and reporting.

charts.title: Share of marketing budgets spent on influencer marketing worldwide as of February 2024
charts.short: Share of marketing budgets spent on influencer marketing worldwide 2024
charts.description: During a global 2024 survey among marketing agencies and brands, 22.4 percent of respondents stated they invested 10 to 20 percent of their marketing budget into influencer marketing. Another 26 percent devoted more than 40 percent to this type of digital marketing activity.
charts.note: Worldwide; 3,000 respondents; among PR agencies, marketing agencies, brands, and other relevant professionals

charts.title: Number of influencers brands worked with worldwide as of February 2024
charts.short: Number of influencers brands worked with worldwide 2024
charts.description: During a global 2024 survey carried out among PR agencies, marketing agencies, brands, and other relevant professionals, 37.6 percent of respondents stated that their organizations worked with up to 10 influencers, whereas 14.7 percent said they worked with over a thousand influencers.
charts.note: Worldwide; as of February 2024; 3,000 respondents; among PR agencies, marketing agencies, brands, and other relevant professionals

charts.title: Leading ways in which influencers can become more valuable to brands according to marketers worldwide as of August 2022
charts.short: Top ways in which influencers can become more valuable to brands worldwide 2022
charts.description: According to a survey conducted among marketers worldwide and released in August 2022, 59 percent of respondents said influencers could become more valuable to brands by creating more interest and purchase intent. This was followed by 51 percent of respondents saying influencers could become more valuable by creating more suitable content for their brand.
charts.source: impact.com; MarketingCharts; WARC Share of respondents
categories: By building more interest and purchase intent
By creating more suitable content for our brand
By building a long-term, collaborative relationship with our brand
By introducing new audiences to a brand
By understanding the brand's requirement better
By allowing more flexibility for content usage rights
By being more professional in their interactions
By giving brands more creative control

charts.title: Leading metrics successfully delivered by influencers according to marketers worldwide as of August 2022
charts.short: Top metrics delivered by influencers according to marketers worldwide 2022
charts.description: According to a survey conducted among marketers in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia and released in August 2022, 32 percent of respondents named increased engagement as the metric most effectively fulfilled by influencer marketing. Around 19 percent of marketers cited social media traffic increase as the best-performing metric delivered by influencers, while 11 percent mentioned a lifting of brand metrics being the most effectively delivered metric.
charts.note: Worldwide; August 20, 2022; <400; marketers in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia
charts.source: impact.com; Net Influencer; WARC Share of respondents

charts.title: Influencer marketing spending worldwide and in the United States in 2022 and 2023 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Influencer marketing spending worldwide and in the U.S. 2022-2023
charts.description: In 2022, influencer marketing spending in the United States equaled 22.19 billion U.S. dollars, which was less than global spending by close to 7 billion, which stood at around 29.14 billion in the given year. During 2023, global influencer marketing spending reached 34.08 billion, while in the U.S. it amounted to 26.09 billion dollars.

charts.title: Leading challenges among influencer marketers worldwide as of January 2023
charts.short: Leading challenges among influencer marketers worldwide 2023
charts.description: According to a global survey conducted among marketers in January 2023, 28 percent of responding social media marketers stated that keeping up with social media trends was one of the top challenges of influencer marketing. The cost of working with influencers came second with 26 percent of respondents listing it as a leading challenge.
charts.note: Worldwide; January 2023; 1,283 respondents; social media marketers
categories: Keeping up with social media trends
The cost of working with influencers
The time it takes to manage campaigns
Finding and vetting influencers to partner with

charts.title: Leading tools for measuring the effectiveness of influencer marketing campaigns worldwide as of January 2023
charts.short: Top tools for measuring the effectiveness of influencer marketing worldwide 2023
charts.description: According to a global survey conducted among social media marketers in January 2023, 34 percent of respondents stated that brand awareness was one of the main tools for measuring the effectiveness of influencer marketing campaigns. Revenue and sales followed with 32 percent, while impressions and views obtained 29 percent of marketers' shares.
charts.note: Worldwide; January 2023; 1,283 respondents; social media marketers

charts.title: Millennials' opinions on how much they trust product/brand recommendations made by social media influencers worldwide in 2023
charts.short: Millennials' trust on product/brand recommendation made by influencers worldwide 2023
charts.description: As of March 2023, nearly 50 percent of 10 millennials worldwide found influencers' recommendations of a brand or product more engaging than regular advertisements. For 36 percent of the respondents, influencer recommendations were also considered more trustworthy than average ads. According to the same report, millennials ranked reliability as the most wanted quality in a brand.
charts.note: Worldwide; March 2023; 3,700 respondents; 27-40 years; in 12 markets
categories: Influencer recommendations are more engaging than regular ads

charts.title: Brand value of TikTok/Douyin worldwide from 2020 to 2023 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: TikTok/Douyin: brand value 2020-2023
charts.description: ByteDance’s triumphant TikTok/ Douyin is one of the most successful Chinese brands that have made its name beyond borders. The short video brand enjoyed immense popularity around the world, surpassing Instagram and WhatsApp to be the most downloaded mobile app. In 2023, the brand value of TikTok/Douyin amounted to 84 billion U.S. dollars. It was the most valuable unicorn worldwide in 2023 with a market cap of 200 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Average number of views per post of TikTok influencers in 2022, by number of followers
charts.short: Views per post of global TikTok influencers 2022, by profile size
charts.description: The post of a TikTok mega-influencer with more than one million followers received an average of 329,382 views worldwide in 2022. The post of a macro-influencer with 100,000 to one million followers received an average of 38,517 views.

charts.title: Distribution of TikTok influencers worldwide in 2022, by number of followers
charts.short: Global distribution of TikTok influencers in 2022, by number of followers
charts.description: In 2022, TikTok influencers with 1,000 to 10,000 followers made up 66.96 percent of TikTok influencer accounts worldwide. The second and third largest groups were micro-influencers with 10,000 to 50,000 followers and mid-tier influencers with 50,000 to 500,000 followers, accounting respectively for 23.06 percent and 9.04 percent.

charts.title: Engagement rate of TikTok influencers worldwide from 2021 to 2023, by number of followers
charts.short: Engagement rate among global TikTok influencers 2023, by profile size
charts.description: TikTok nano-influencers with one to 10 thousand followers had the highest engagement rate (ER) compared to other TikTok profiles worldwide in 2023. Nano-influencers had an ER of 11.97 percent, while micro-influencers with 10,000 to 50,000 followers came second with 10.21 percent.

charts.title: Number of fake interactions removed on TikTok from 2nd quarter 2021 to 4th quarter 2023 (in millions)
charts.short: TikTok: fake engagement removed 2021-2023
charts.description: During the fourth quarter of 2023, the social video platform TikTok removed around 720 million fake followers on the platform due to fake accounts. This represents a staggering increase from the previous quarter, when the number of fake followers removed was approximately 211 million. Additionally, the platform removed around 1.03 billion fake likes during the last measured quarter.

charts.title: Fastest growing TikTok accounts worldwide in 2022, by annual follower growth
charts.short: Fastest growing global TikTok accounts 2022, by follower growth
charts.description: The fastest-growing TikTok user worldwide in 2022 was Brazilian sports influencer Luva de Pedreiro, who grew his audience by 1,546 percent compared to the previous year. Online personality and pastry chef Amaury Guichon was the second fastest growing global TikTok creators in 2022, with a follower growth of almost 736 percent year-over-year.
charts.source: HypeAuditor Year-on-year follower growth TikTok username

charts.title: Most-followed creators on TikTok worldwide as of March 2024 (in millions)
charts.short: Most popular TikTok users worldwide 2024
charts.description: As of March 2024, TikTok creator and comedian Khabane Lame was the most followed content creator on the platform. Lame, who is based in Italy, reached 161.4 million subscribers. Influencer Charlie D'Amelio followed closely in second position with 152 million followers and singer Bella Poarch ranked third, with a total of 93.9 million followers.
charts.source: Social Blade Number of followers in millions

charts.title: Leading brands on TikTok worldwide in 2022, by number of influencers mentioning them (in 1,000s)
charts.short: Most mentioned brands on TikTok worldwide 2022, by influencers
charts.description: The most talked-about brand on TikTok in 2022 was online fashion and sports retailer Shein, having been mentioned by 13.4 thousand influencers. Target followed with 11.2 thousand influencers, while Netflix rounded out the top three with 8.5 thousand.
charts.source: HypeAuditor Number of influencers in thousands

charts.title: Leading brands on TikTok worldwide in 2023, by number of influencers (in 1,000s)
charts.short: Most talked about brands on TikTok worldwide 2023
charts.description: Target was the most talked about brand on TikTok in 2023, with 21 thousand influencers mentioning it. Netflix and Amazon followed with 18.8 thousand and 16.3 thousand influencers, respectively.
charts.source: HypeAuditor Number of influencers in thousands

charts.title: Brand value of Instagram worldwide from 2020 to 2023 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Instagram: brand value 2020-2023
charts.description: In 2023, the brand value of Instagram amounted to 47.4 billion U.S. dollars. A year earlier, the value stood at 33.48 billion dollars. Instagram was the sixth most valuable media brand worldwide in 2023.

charts.title: Leading countries based on Instagram audience size as of January 2024 (in millions)
charts.short: Countries with the most Instagram users 2024
charts.description: As of January 2024, India had a total of 362 million Instagram users, the largest Instagram audience in the world. The United States had 169 million users, and Brazil had 134 million. Indonesia, Turkey, and Japan ranked in fourth, fifth and sixth position, respectively. Brunei is the leading country for Instagram audience reach, with 92 percent of the population using the social media service. Guam came in second, with a penetration rate of 79.2 percent and the Cayman Islands ranked [...]
charts.note: Worldwide; January 2024; 13 years and older; based on addressable ad audience
charts.source: DataReportal; Meltwater; Meta Platforms; We Are Social Audience in millions

charts.title: Average number of weekly brand posts on Instagram in 2023, by vertical
charts.short: Average weekly Instagram brand posts 2023, by vertical
charts.description: In 2023, the median weekly brand posts on social media app Instagram was 4.7 posts. Overall, sports teams added an average of 18 posts weekly to the social network, while media brands generated an average of 12.2 posts. Additionally, retail brands posted on average 5.7 times per week, whilst fashion brands posted 6.1 times per week.
charts.source: Rival IQ Number of Instagram posts per week

charts.title: Distribution of Instagram influencers worldwide in 2023, by category
charts.short: Share of Instagram influencers worldwide 2023, by category
charts.description: According to the findings of a study examining the state of influencer marketing on Instagram, 8.35 percent of influencers on the platform were focused on the beauty topics, making it the third most popular category among global Instagram influencers in 2023. Lifestyle was the most popular category covered by Instagram influencers that year, with a share of 13.73 percent.

charts.title: Distribution of Instagram influencers worldwide in 2023, by number of followers
charts.short: Global distribution of Instagram influencers in 2023, by number of followers
charts.description: In 2023, Instagram influencers with 1,000 to 10,000 followers accounted for 76.86 percent of influencer accounts worldwide. The second most popular group was that of micro-influencers with 10,000 to 50,000 subscribers, accounting for 18.23 percent of all influencers. Mid-tier influencers with 50,000 to 500,000 followers represented 4.56 percent of the total, while mega-influencers and celebrities with more than one million subscribers accounted for 0.16 percent.

charts.title: Engagement rates among Instagram influencers worldwide in 2022-2023, by number of followers
charts.short: Engagement rates among global IG influencers 2022-2023, by profile size
charts.description: According to a study of Instagram (IG) influencer engagement rates (ER) worldwide, nano influencers have been seeing the highest popularity compared to other tier profiles. Influencers who had between one to ten thousand followers had tan engagement rate of 2.19 percent in 2023. On average the ER for all studied IG influencers stood at 1.85 percent in the same year.

charts.title: Share of Instagram influencers involved in fraud worldwide from 2022-2023, by number of followers
charts.short: Share of fraudulent Instagram influencers worldwide 2022-2023, by number of followers
charts.description: A majority of Instagram mega-influencers with more than one million followers worldwide were involved in fraudulent activities to inflate their engagement and follower figures in 2023. Mega-influencers and celebrities involved in fraud were 58.5 percent of the total in the same year. The average share of influencers involved in fraud went down with 2.15 percent and reached was of 43.17 percent.

charts.title: Leading brands on Instagram worldwide in 2022, by number of influencers mentioning them (in 1,000s)
charts.short: Leading brands on Instagram worldwide 2022, by influencers
charts.description: Instagram was the most talked about brand on Instagram worldwide in 2022, with 85.5 thousand influencers mentioning it. Zara followed with 66.4 thousand influencers, while Shein rounded out the top three with 57.2 thousand.
charts.source: HypeAuditor Number of influencers in thousands

charts.title: Average ad fraud rates of Instagram influencers worldwide from 2019 to 2023
charts.short: Average fraud rates of Instagram influencers 2019-2023
charts.description: Average influencer fraud rates (ER) worldwide had decreased gradually since 2019. The fraud rate was about 63 percent in 2019, only to drop to 45 percent four years later, in 2022 and then raised back again in 2023, to 49.19 percent on average. The influencer fraud rates are based on buying followers, likes and comments, stories views, and comment pods.

charts.title: Brand value of YouTube worldwide from 2020 to 2023 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: YouTube: brand value 2020-2023
charts.description: In 2023, the brand value of YouTube stood at 29.71 billion U.S. dollars. A year earlier, the value was estimated at 23.89 billion dollars. YouTube is the eight most valuable media brand worldwide.

charts.title: Distribution of YouTube influencers worldwide in 2023, by category
charts.short: Global distribution of YouTube influencers 2023, by category
charts.description: People and blogs was the most popular category for YouTube influencers in 2023, with 28.5 percent of them posting videos related to this topic. Entertainment and video games followed with a respective influencer share of 14.54 and 12.95 percent.

charts.title: YouTube influencer engagement rates worldwide in 2023, by follower count
charts.short: YouTube influencer engagement rates worldwide 2023
charts.description: In 2023, YouTube influencers with between 1,000 and 5,000 followers had an engagement rate, amounting to 1.9 percent. The rate for influencers with more 1,000,000 followers was higher - 3.4 percent.

charts.title: Fastest growing YouTube accounts worldwide in 2022, by annual follower growth
charts.short: Fastest growing YouTube accounts worldwide 2022
charts.description: Indian YouTube channel Shorts Break was the fastest-growing video account on the platform in 2022, with an annual follower growth of 2,130 percent. Vlog and online creator NichLmao followed with 382 percent. In the last examined year, several channels creating children's entertainment content (Kids Diana Show, Like Nastya, checkgate) ranked among the fastest growing on YouTube.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2022; *AddictedA1 changed their YouTube account name to CarryMinati since the publication of the report. Read more
charts.source: HypeAuditor Year-on-year follower growth YouTube accounts

charts.title: Number of YouTube creators with more than 10 million followers worldwide in September 2022, by country
charts.short: Number of supernova creators on YouTube worldwide 2022
charts.description: On September 15, 2022, the United States was home to 266 creators with more than 10 million followers, which made it the country with the highest number of supernova creators on YouTube worldwide. India ranked second, with 188 supernova creators, followed by Brazil with 80.
